items.teaser: The Economic and Financial Crimes Commission, EFCC, has been asked to execute a long-standing arrest warrant against Mrs Seinye Lulu-Briggs. The warrant was issued on May 16, 2022 by Justice Taiwo O. Taiwo of the Federal High Court, Abuja, in a suit numbered FHC/ABJ/CS/653/2022.
